6%: RBI may hike interest rates by 75 basis points by Q2 of next year: Goldman Sachs

• The Reserve Bank of India is projected to increase interest rates by 75 basis points by the second quarter of 2027.

Context:
• Analysts predict that headline inflation will remain above 6 percent into early 2027 before gradually decreasing.
• Despite the monetary tightening, India's GDP growth is expected to moderate to 7.2 percent in 2027.

Source: Economic Times · 19 November 2026
